definition: The ISLRN or International Standard Language Resource Number is Persistent Unique Identifier for Language Resources..
details: The ISLRN or International Standard Language Resource Number is Persistent Unique Identifier for Language Resources.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. Think of it this way: The ISLRN or International Standard Language Resource Number is Persistent Unique Identifier for Language Resources.. And here is the clever part: The ISLRN or International Standard Language Resource Number is Persistent Unique Identifier for Language Resources. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is ISLRN — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
